What to look for, issue 3708. `okLiteral[10]` is the control: every pane
accepts it, so any pane that rejects only the swizzled and subscripted
bounds is objecting to those, not to the stage, the profile or the buffer.
This is a compute restating of the pixel repro measured locally, because
clang's DXIL backend cannot lower a pixel shader writing SV_Target.

  FXC cs_5_0    exit 0 -- folds the component and accepts all four bounds.
  DXC 1.6.2112  three errors, one per swizzled/subscripted bound.
  DXC trunk     the same three. Unchanged in all 20 releases v1.4.1907 on.
  clang trunk   accepts `(10).x` -- the case this issue was filed about --
                and rejects the other two, its own note blaming the read of
                a non-constexpr variable rather than the component access.
                Spelled `constexpr uint2`, clang accepts those too; neither
                FXC nor DXC knows the keyword.
